top_choice_rationale: P001 is the clearest attributable achievement on the slate: Buchwald and Hartwig independently developed ligand-controlled Pd-catalysed C-N coupling, a mechanism-driven solution to slow C-N reductive elimination and beta-hydride elimination that is distinct from the 2010 C-C couplings, with about thirty years of independent confirmation and broad use. Kosugi's stoichiometric tin-amide chemistry is a precursor for the citation background, not a third seat. P002 follows because its reversible-terminator chemistry has a defined chemical principle and a clean two-name core, although Rothberg, Ju and Mayer are left out. P004 has the broadest support, but I cannot settle six credited names within three seats. P003 pairs two unrelated achievements and base editing is recent after the 2020 prize, yet each part is sound and still better than no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; I am a Stockholm University colleague of Xiaodong Zou, who has no tie to any credited laureate, and my work on respiratory electron and proton transfer is only scientifically near B017, which is not on the slate.
